page.layout: One page of text; running head at top centre; small decorative mark at top right margin (no text). Main text in one block, with two headed sections and italic Latin verse.

main_text.head: EOBANI HESSI, CLARISS. Germaniæ Poetæ, Homeri Iliada & Theocriti Idyllia Latinis versibus feliciter interpretati, Memoriæ.
main_text.p: NV per Lethæas Eobanum Generat Hessum Transfuecturus aquas portitor ille Charon, Multa minans, Siculi calamos impune poetæ, Maonidaque aufo furripuisse tubam: Quinetiam media Yates iam puppe sedebat, Quum prohibes nautam pergere Mercurius, Nesciuto, senex, inquit, sibi vindicat istum, Istum, inquam, superum turba beata sibi. Nam qui alijs potuit Yitam producere, certè Infera iuris in hunc obtinet aula nihil.
main_text.head: FRANCISCI PORTI, CRETENSIS, suæ, id est, Græcæ linguæ, in Academia Genevensi Professoris clarissimi & amici summi, Memoriæ.
main_text.p: CRetensem patria Portum, non moribus, oras Traxerat in Venetas quem pietatis amor: amor:

p.i: Nec satis in Venetis natum felicitér orîs, Quærere suadebat quod pietatis amor:

page.notes: Large woodcut initials N and C at the starts of the verse paragraphs; the Greek-looking word "Yates" and "Yitam" are probably long-s/Y-type initial forms, read as printed with [?] uncertainty. Line "Quum prohibes..." and "Mercurius" read as printed. Catchword "Hospitio" at the foot right. Page number not printed.
